player.title: Player registration
player.description: Visione-X screens run the dedicated Android player app on the Android box connected to your LED controller.
player.step1: Install the Visione-X Player app on the Android box.
player.step2: Open the app. It shows a pairing code and QR code on the screen.
player.step3: Sign in to Visione-X, open Screens and choose Add screen, then enter the code.
player.step4: An organization admin authorizes the screen before content is delivered.
